info.name: Allows investor to approve access to his/her account

params.name: scope
params.description: Not used. Leave this blank — Alto does not scope access; a token grants full access to the investor's account.

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: Must match what we have on file

items.docs: Once access is approved by the investor, we will generate an auth "code" and send it back to your `redirect_uri` in a query string parameter named "code".

info.name: Allows the user to complete the funding process

params.name: platform_code
params.description: The code assigned to your account (ie: angellist)

params.name: external_id
params.description: The ID you use internally to identify this Offering

items.docs: Ensure that you have first enabled access to the Offering for this investor (see /api/platform/offering/{external_id}/enable_for_investor)
